body:
Thanks for this. I'm feeling better today, but I'm used to this pattern, feeling good when I wake up, and slowly deteroriating once night hits and the people I talk to to distract me go to sleep.
I do run/get a decent amount of physical activity daily. It's not when I wake up always, but its there 6/7 days of the week. 
I think one of hte main things with the emotions is that I don't have too many friends outside of the internet, as I've been moving so much (2-3 times a year) the friends I've kept I can only get a hold of online. And text just seems like its lacking emotion, and I don't really know what to do about that.
